issue_title: PluginManager.register leaves partial state after validation failure
issue_body: A failed PluginManager.register() call can leave a plugin partially registered when a later hook implementation fails validation. On main at 9836e545d68690b30accc1eeb4af408f80efa44, a plugin with a valid a_hook and invalid b_hook raises PluginValidationError but remains in the manager and leaves a_hook installed. Expected: registration failure leaves no plugin mapping or hook implementations, so callers can safely fix and retry. The register implementation currently contains a TODO noting that state should not change on failure.
source_method: local path import after Product GitHub import returned HTTP 429
